ety.text: Literally, "to put (one's) foot on the embers".
Borrowed from Classical Persian عجیب و غریب ('ajīb-u-ġarīb). By surface analysis, अजीब (ajīb, “strange”) + -ओ- (-o-) + ग़रीब (ġarīb, “poor; strange (obsolete)”).
